uutiset.t: Arsenal go six points clear after lively draw at Newcastle
uutiset.s: Noni Madueke's second-half goal earns Arsenal a 2-2 draw against Newcastle United at St James' Park, as the reigning champions move six points clear at the top of the Premier League table.

uutiset.t: Evanilson strikes again as Bournemouth beat Forest
uutiset.s: Evanilson scores in his sixth consecutive Premier League game, as Bournemouth defeat Nottingham Forest 2-0 at the Vitality Stadium.

uutiset.t: Leeds dominate Chelsea for first Stamford Bridge win since 1999
uutiset.s: Noah Okafor scores twice to deliver Leeds United's first win at Chelsea in 27 years, in an impressive 4-1 victory at Stamford Bridge. They move up to sixth in the Premier League.

uutiset.t: Man City drop points to Fulham despite superb Anderson volley
uutiset.s: Elliot Anderson's fantastic volley earns Manchester City a first Premier League point in over a month as they come from behind to hold Fulham.

uutiset.t: Teenager Williams-Barnett shines as Spurs beat Ipswich
uutiset.s: Tottenham Hotspur teenager Luca Williams-Barnett starres for Roberto de Zerbi's side as they comfortably beat Ipswich Town.

uutiset.t: Villa's home woes continue as Sunderland earn point
uutiset.s: Aston Villa's struggles at home this season continue as they are held to a goalless draw by Sunderland in the Premier League.

uutiset.t: Coventry beat Palace in Frank's first game after late own goal
uutiset.s: A Dwight McNeil own goal in the 85th minute gives Coventry City a 3-2 win to move three points clear of the relegation zone, as Thomas Frank's first game in charge at Crystal Palace ends in defeat in the Premier League.

uutiset.t: Can win over All Blacks finally break England's boom-bust cycle?
uutiset.s: Twelve months ago, England beat New Zealand and flopped in the following Six Nations. Can their 2026 success pave the way to more permanent success?

uutiset.t: Who was 'a consistent threat'? Newcastle v Arsenal player ratings
uutiset.s: BBC Sport's Alex Howell shares his player ratings for Newcastle and Arsenal's 2-2 draw in the Premier League - and you can rate the players too.

uutiset.t: 'The world got to see today' - who is new Spurs star Williams-Barnett?
uutiset.s: BBC Sport looks at Tottenham's new teenage star after Luca Williams-Barnett makes a superb full Premier League debut for Spurs

uutiset.t: 'Fragile' and 'miles off it' - Alonso's Chelsea honeymoon is over
uutiset.s: The honeymoon period is over for Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso, who is now in firefighting mode after a 4-1 defeat by Leeds at Stamford Bridge.

uutiset.t: Ireland beat world champions South Africa in thriller
uutiset.s: Ireland exact revenge on world champions South Africa with a thrilling win in Dublin after England's victory over New Zealand dashed Andy Farrell's side's hopes of reaching next weekend's Nations Championship final.

uutiset.t: Keating stars as Liverpool hold high-flying Chelsea to goalless draw
uutiset.s: Chelsea miss the chance to consolidate their lead over Manchester City at the top of the Women's Super League as they fail to breach a stubborn Liverpool at the sunny St Helen's Stadium.

uutiset.t: 'Officials can't use common sense' - was Rogers handball correct?
uutiset.s: The decision to give Leeds a crucial penalty in their win at Chelsea reopens the Premier League handball debate around intent.

uutiset.t: Scotland kept 'foot on throat' in ruthless display - captain McDowall
uutiset.s: Stand-in captain Stafford McDowall praises Scotland for keeping their "foot on the throat" of opponents Japan in their thumping 67-5 Nations Championship win.
